title: CanvasTEKK workflow run result file, layout 1.0.0
description: Platform-owned layout of a workflow run result file. Header keys come first, in this order: result_file_version, result_schema, result_schema_version, workflow_run_id, generated_at, summary (optional); body comes last. body is owned by the producing app and is never validated by the platform. summary must also be at most 2048 bytes as compact UTF-8 JSON (checked in code; JSON Schema cannot express it).

result_schema.description: App-chosen label naming the shape of body: app.kind, snake_case parts (e.g. model_check.rule).

workflow_run_id.description: Run id from the node execution request.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

summary.description: Optional flat key-value pairs, app-defined keys, scalar values only, at most 2048 bytes.
